overview_description.description:
Based in Austin, Texas, Mio is the leading provider of messaging interoperability solutions. Mio Universal Channels enable intercompany collaboration by connecting users on Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Webex Teams.

By enabling external contacts to chat in Universal Channels, everyone can share files, reply to threads, and edit messages—all from their tool of choice.

The company, founded by Tom Hadfield and James Cundle, has raised $12m from investors including Goldcrest Capital, Eniac Ventures, Two Sigma Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Y Combinator, and Capital Factory.

Ready to chat better, together?
Install directly at www.m.io

about_short_description.short_description: Chat better, together. Mio powers seamless intercompany communication across Slack, Microsoft Teams, & Webex Teams.

product.name: Mio Interoperability Platform
product.description: An API-driven integration that relays chats, files, and user information between Google Chat, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom Team Chat, and Webex while users remain in their existing applications.

product.name: Chat Sync
product.description: A cross-platform messaging integration that synchronizes direct messages, channels, and spaces between supported workplace chat platforms, including Google Chat, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom Team Chat, and Webex.

product.name: Directory Sync
product.description: A bidirectional user-directory synchronization service that imports and maintains identities across collaboration platforms, making colleagues discoverable for cross-platform communication.

product.name: External Chat Sync
product.description: A cross-platform messaging service for communicating with contacts outside an organization, initially supporting external collaboration between Google Chat and Microsoft Teams.

product.name: File Sync
product.description: A file-sharing interoperability service that relays files and links between connected collaboration platforms, including Google Drive and SharePoint, so users can access shared content across systems.

product.name: Mio Hub
product.description: An administrative console for connecting messaging platforms, synchronizing users and channels, configuring deployments, and monitoring interoperability activity across an organization.
